question_en: What is the name of the shopping center where this group of shops is located, and in which city in Japan is it situated?
answer: 打越ショッピングセンター (shopping center); Himeji City (姫路市)
gold_trajectory:
# Detailed Simulated Retrieval Trajectory · 2-2-G01

## Step 01 · Treat the two street view images as combined clues for the same location

**Action:** Image 1 records an open-air narrow alley, a green-and-white striped awning, a second-floor railing, and an air conditioner on the right; Image 2 records a yellow-and-white striped awning, a large cyan-green awning, and the positions of doors and windows. A sample query is "レトロ 商店街 路地 緑 白 ストライプ テント".

**Evidence Observation:** The people in the current input have been pixelated, and parts such as shop signs in Image 2 have been removed; therefore, shop names cannot be read from non-existent text first. First, find a location that can simultaneously explain the architectural and awning relationships in both images, then read the place name from the source page.

## Step 02 · Retrieve the two original images from the same travelogue

**Action:** Review azusa89's travelogue dated March 19, 2025, and match the two photos in the article to the input images respectively, rather than drawing a conclusion using only one similar photo of an old street.

Source travelogue:
https://note.com/azusa89/n/nebd9d984e71d

First original image:
https://assets.st-note.com/img/1742390773-fIyt91oSe0Nb2Gh7sZJMQBE4.jpg?width=1200

Second original image:
https://assets.st-note.com/img/1742390771-BL0FcQEzaibj5uHwpRkT1Xye.jpg?width=1200

**Evidence Observation:** The hanging position of the striped awning in Image 1 corresponds to the relative positions of the railing and air conditioner; the yellow-and-white awning, the large cyan-green awning, and the door/window combination in Image 2 correspond. Matching is based on preserved architectural structures, excluding modified shop sign areas, people, or added plants. The article explicitly records the location as 打越ショッピングセンター (shopping center), located in 姫路市 (Himeji City).

## Step 03 · Verify the location with another visit report and exclude similar markets

**Action:** Review another author's record of visiting this place on December 12, 2021, to confirm that different perspectives still connect to the same narrow alley and awnings; simultaneously distinguish other markets mentioned in the same station article.

Second page related to 打越:
https://retro.useless-landscape.com/archives/28846/2/

Reverse perspective of the same alley, overview of the same awning and alley:
https://retro.useless-landscape.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/20-1.jpg

https://retro.useless-landscape.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/16-1.jpg

https://retro.useless-landscape.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/15-1.jpg

**Evidence Observation:** The striped awning and alley boundaries in the reverse perspective can connect to Image 1; another photo can correspond to the large awning and storefront in Image 2. The Yashiro Market involved on the first page of that article features an indoor passage and should not be treated as the target simply because it shares the same article number as the second page; the Sone Market also differs in its continuous canopy, openings, and facade combination.

Yashiro Market page and reference photos:
https://retro.useless-landscape.com/archives/28846/

https://retro.useless-landscape.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/06-2.jpg

Sone Market page and reference photos:
https://retro.useless-landscape.com/archives/28810/

https://retro.useless-landscape.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/03-1.jpg

## Step 04 · Extract the market name and city without extending to operational status

**Action:** Extract "打越ショッピングセンター (shopping center)" and "姫路市 (Himeji City)" from the visit reports that have been matched to the photos. If using subsequent shop information to verify the address, treat it only as supplementary material after the location has been determined.

Shop link saved in the question package:
https://tabelog.com/hyogo/A2805/A280501/28068961/

**Evidence Boundary:** The old collection record for this shop link returned a 403 error; it cannot be written as successfully opened this time, nor is it needed to complete the judgment. The shop name is unreadable in the processed question image and cannot be reverse-engineered as an initial OCR clue. Historical visit reports support the location identity but do not imply that the same operational status is maintained currently.

**Stopping Condition:** The matching of the two images from the same source plus the cross-verification from another visit report at a different angle already supports the location and city; per the question requirements, output only these two items.

## Formal Answer

打越ショッピングセンター (shopping center); Himeji City (姫路市)
